methods.name: tanks
methods.description: Get all the 'tanks' stored in this block. Each tank can hold a single fluid.
methods.shortDescription: Get the tanks in this storage.

returnValues.name: tanks
description: The different tanks in this fluid storage. Each tank is a table containing the following parameters:
- `name`: The name of the fluid stored in the tank.
- `amount`: The current amount of fluid stored in this tank.
returnValues.shortDescription: The different tanks in this fluid storage.

methods.name: pushFluid
methods.description: Pushes a fluid from this container to another. Throws an error if the target container does not exist on the network. The target container does not need to have the `fluid_storage` type to receive fluids.
methods.shortDescription: Pushes a fluid from this container to another.

arguments.name: toName
arguments.description: The target container to push fluid to. If this target does not exist on the network, will throw an error.
arguments.shortDescription: The target container to push fluid to.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: The maximum amount of fluid to push. Note that this is a limit, not an absolute amount. If the target storage cannot hold this amount of fluid, it will instead only push as much fluid as it can hold.
arguments.shortDescription: The maximum amount of fluid to push.

arguments.name: fluidName
arguments.description: If this fluid storage supports multiple tanks, you can specify the fluid to move by its name. If this is omitted, an arbitrary fluid will be selected.

methods.name: pullFluid
methods.description: Pulls a fluid from the target container to this one. Throws an error if the target container does not exist on the network. The target container does not need to have the `fluid_storage` type to send fluids.
methods.shortDescription: Pulls a fluid from another container to this one.

arguments.name: fromName
arguments.description: The target container to pull fluid from. If this target does not exist on the network, will throw an error.
arguments.shortDescription: The target container to pull fluid from.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.description: The maximum amount of fluid to pull. Note that this is a limit, not an absolute amount. If this storage cannot hold this amount of fluid, it will instead only pull as much fluid as it can hold.
arguments.shortDescription: The maximum amount of fluid to push.

arguments.name: fluidName
arguments.description: If the target fluid storage supports multiple tanks, you can specify the fluid to move by its name. If this is omitted, an arbitrary fluid will be selected.
